179994.overview:
Welcome to the world of crazy chain reactions!
Kick, jump, roll your brain to the next level. Solve riddles from the Scattered Professor.
Create crazy and funny contraptions.
Share them with friends.
Experience incredible fun with physics and the wackiest puzzles in the world in a game the whole family can enjoy!

180837.overview:
Crayon Shin-Chan: Obaka Dainin Den: Susume! Kasukabe Ninja Tai! is an action adventure game where players follow the antics of Shinnosuke Nohara (Shin-chan) and his friends as they form the Kasukabe Ninja Squad. 

The game involves platforming, combat, and puzzle-solving, with each character having unique abilities to navigate through various levels and overcome obstacles.

181090.overview: Center Shiken: Eigo Listening Sokushuu DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Good-Feel and published by Educational Network, which was released in Japan in 2009.

181093.overview: Chibi Maruko-Chan DS: Maru-Chan no Machi is an Action game, developed by Hyde and published by Bandai Namco Games, which was released in Japan in 2009.

181094.overview: Chishiki-Ou Series: Train Master is a Simulation game, developed and published by Global A, which was released in Japan in 2008.

181095.overview: Choco Ken no Dekitate Sweets Wagon is an Action game, developed and published by Creative Core, which was released in Japan in 2009.

181096.overview: Chocobo to Mahou no Ehon: Majo to Shoujo to Go-nin no Yuusha is an Adventure game, developed by h.a.n.d. Inc. and published by Square Enix, which was released in Japan in 2008.

181097.overview: The developer Alchemist gathers together a total of 63 scary stories and bulks them up into visual novels filled with images, sound effects, and narration from Akira Hirayama.

181098.overview: Chou!! Nep League DS is a Sports game, developed and published by Jaleco Entertainment, which was released in Japan in 2008.

181099.overview: Chuukana Janshi Tenhoo Painyan Remix is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Jaleco Entertainment, which was released in Japan in 2007.

181100.overview: Cookin' Idol I! My! Main! Game de Hirameki! Kirameki Cooking is a Simulation game, developed and published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 2010.

181175.overview: Cosmetic Paradise: Kirei no Mahou is a Simulation game, developed and published by Global A, which was released in Japan in 2010.

181176.overview: Crayon Shin-Chan Shokkugan! Densetsu o Yobu Omake Daiketsusen!! is a game based on the "Crayon Shin-chan" series. In this action-adventure game, players take on the role of Shin-chan and other characters as they embark on various missions and challenges. The game features a mix of platforming, combat, and puzzle-solving elements, staying true to the humorous and playful nature of the series.

181238.overview:
Shin Chan: Adventures in Cineland (Shin Chan: Arashi no Yobu Cinema - Land no Daibouken ?) is a video game released for Game Boy Advance on April 16, 2004. A remake on the DS titled Crayon Shin -Chan: Arashi o Yobu Cinema-Land: Kachinko Gachinko Daikatsugeki! was released in 2008.

In this game, Shin-chan and his family visit Cinema Land where they go through to a parallel dimension where Action Kamen is a real thing, and they must help him to beat the Haigure Mao.

182442.overview: La Carte au Trésor: Le Jeu Vidéo Officiel (Translates to The Treasure Map: The Official Video Game) is an adventure game for Nintendo DS. Based on the concept of the French TV show of the same name, the game puts you in control of a pair of contestants determined to be the first to get their hands on an extraordinary treasure. Meet the locals and move around the map to complete physical and logical challenges and thus obtain the necessary clues to locate the treasure!

182443.overview: Cédric: Chen's Birthday on Nintendo DS is a game that follows the course of a comic book with the ups and downs known by the blond troublemaker. During his progression, the player must succeed in climbing the levels in five different mini-games, whether it is for example to pass the mower or to tidy his room.

184833.overview: Chuugaku Eitango Target 1800 DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by IE Institute, which was released in Japan in 2006

184851.overview: The premise of Cut the Rope is simple: a cute alien called Om Nom is hungry for candy, and it’s your job to make sure that he gets it. What follows is a physics-based puzzle game where you cut ropes to swing and manoeuvre the candy into Om Nom’s mouth. Holding the DSi on its side — in a 'book' style — you cut ropes with a simple swipe of the stylus, while there are also air balloons to tap, bubbles that enable the candy to float and moveable anchors to manipulate the angle and tension of the line. As you would expect of a puzzle game designed solely for touchscreens, it all feels intuitive and easy to play.

185934.overview:
The Invaders of the untherworld 'Nenne Nesia' have begun to move. Something
shimmering that Shin accidentally picked up has created a hole for the 
exit of the invaders! The invaders began to gather in the underworld
 all over the earth! !Shin will have to go out for an adventure together
 with Colon to stop the invasion of the Nendo world!

186491.overview: Tomyka Hero: Rescue Force DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Takara Tomy, which was released in Japan in 2008.

191036.overview: Chikyuu no Arukikata DS: France-Hen is a miscellaneous game, developed by Will and published by Square Enix, which was released in Japan in 2007.

191048.overview: Chikyuu no Arukikata DS - Thai-Hen is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Will and published by Square Enix, which was released in Japan in 2007.

191049.overview: Card de Asobu! Hajimete no DS is a Board game, developed and published by Sega, which was released in Japan in 2009.

191050.overview: Card Game 9 is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Access and published by Taito Corporation, which was released in Japan in 2006.

191051.overview: There are more than 1000 kinds of parts. Create, collect, and exchange your own unique and fun characters! Overview: "Chara-Chainco" is a new type of game software that allows players to create, collect, and play with their own original character "Peller" by using over 1000 different parts. Peller" is somehow flappable, and can move around the 3D "Chara-Chenco Land", play various mini-games, compete in mini-games with friends via DS wireless communication, and exchange characters and parts to create new characters. The game is also compatible with the Nintendo Dsi camera function, allowing users to create characters using their face photos. Create, collect, and play with characters, offering a new way to play with the Nintendo DS! Floppy characters that move around the 3D world. Who will create the strongest character? Who will create the strongest character? Peller" : With more than 1000 different parts, adjustable colors and positions of parts, and a body shape adjustment function, you can make your character look just like you, your friends, or your favorite celebrities and athletes. The more you play mini-games, make more "Pellers", and exchange them via DS wireless communication, the more parts you can use as you progress through the game. The "Camera Function" on the DSi allows you to capture your face! The "Peller" can be made by taking a picture of your face with the Nintendo Dsi camera and pasting it onto the "Peller". Combine various parts to transform yourself into a pirate or an alien! You can also play with it. Exchange "Peller" and other parts via DS wireless communication! You can exchange "Peller" and other parts created by you and your partner via DS wireless communication. The strength of the "Peller" you create will be automatically determined. You can show off your interesting "Peller" to everyone, compete with each other for "strength", and play in many other ways. You can show off your Peller and compete with others in a 3D world. There are also games that can be played against each other via DS wireless play. Some mini-games change the strength and speed of Peller depending on his parts and body shape, so you can try out different games with your strongest Peller. / Mini-games to compete! Collect coins and parts to make the strongest Peller: Challenge the slots with the coins you collected in the mini-games. Get new parts. 10 mini-games in which "Peller" plays an active role! [Players: 1 player (2 to 4 players via wireless communication) (CERO Age rating: All ages)

191052.overview: The Conveni DS: Otona no Keiei Ryoku Training is a Strategy game, developed by Hamster and published by Nippon Ichi Software, which was released in Japan in 2008.

191054.overview: Chubaw Desuyo! Kyoushou Recipe Shuu is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Alpha Unit, which was released in Japan in 2007.

191055.overview: Chou Kantan Boki Nyuumon DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by IE Institute, which was released in Japan in 2007.

191056.overview: Crossword de Manabou! Chiri - Rekishi is a Puzzle game, developed by AI and published by Hudson, which was released in Japan in 2007.

191078.overview: Chokkan! Asonde Relaxuma is an Action game, developed and published by Rocket Company, which was released in Japan in 2008.

191079.overview: This DS game is a visual novel game adaptation of "Farewell, My Lovely" detective novel written by Raymond Chandler which spanned several movie adaptations. This time, the player takes on the role of Philip Marlowe, private investigator. While on a case, a big guy called Moose Malloy enter the bar looking for his old flame, Velma Valento. Marlowe steps in to calm down the big guy and hears his story. Seems he's been in prison for 8 years and Velma wasn't interested in waiting. Marlowe reluctantly offers his help if Moose promises to calm down and not do anything rash in the meantime. Expecting a quick conclusion, the great P.I. finds himself entangled in Velma's drama filled with intrigues and deceptions.

191080.overview:
"Cocoro no Cocoron" is a lifesimulation game where players assume the role of Mirumiru, a young girl who is teleported to the magical Cocoron World. 

The main objective is to explore this whimsical planet, interact with its unique inhabitants, and build friendships. Starting in a small area, players gradually expand their reach, meet various creatures, and uncover the secrets of Cocoron World through their interactions and adventures.

191081.overview: Custom Beat Battle: Draglade 2"is an fighting game where players engage in 2D battles using characters equipped with Glades and Bullets. These weapons allow for a variety of attacks and combos. The game includes both single-player and multiplayer modes, with Wi-Fi support for online play. Players can customize their characters and Glades to create unique fighting styles and strategies, adding depth to the combat experience.

191082.overview: Custom Mahjong is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Affect and published by Success, which was released in Japan in 2007.

191087.overview: Ciao Dream Touch!: Happy Anniversary is a unique, Japan-exclusive puzzle/simulation game released for the Nintendo DS on December 7, 2006. Developed and published by Marvelous Interactive, the game was created to celebrate the 30th anniversary of Shogakukan's Ciao (Chao) shōjo manga magazine.

191090.overview: Cosmetic * Paradise: Princess Life is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Global A, which was released in Japan in 2011.

191092.overview:
Get sweets by flipping Cinnamoroll with the "Splash Flipper"! There are plenty of gimmicks that use the unique features of the DS, such as blowing on the microphone to stop Cinnamon from falling between the flippers, or touching the lower screen to shake the pinball board.

Of course, Cinnamon's friends are also involved. They come to help Cinnamon on the way, and there are also mini games for each character. As you progress through the game, you will be able to read stories and even fill in cute coloring pages of Cinnamoroll.

191473.overview: This game features a collection of crossword puzzles. The words can be filled in with the stylus. A feature of this game is that it includes crosswords from around the globe to solve.

191542.overview: Chi's Sweet Home: Chi ga Ouchi ni Yatte Kita! is a Simulation game, developed and published by Interchannel, which was released in Japan in 2008.

191543.overview: Welcome to Sweet City, home of chocodogs and chococats! Our sweet-toothed friends are thrilled with the brand new Sweet Superstore that's opened in the middle of town, filled with all kinds of exciting shops. Each season, the superstore holds events and fairs that are the pride of this bustling town. Now you have the chance to explore this lively new place and see for yourself how the different shop owners work hard to make it such a success! Help Rose, a chocodog create and manage the Cookie Shop of your dreams: choose the best furniture and layout, cook the best cakes, network with the other shop owners in the mall and develop your customer base! Don't forget that a good client is a happy one!

191827.overview: Chuugaku Junbi: 5 Kyouka Kanpeki DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Benesse, which was released in Japan in 2011.

192146.overview: Croket! DS: Tenkuu no Yuushatachi is a Strategy game, developed by Jupiter Corporation and published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 2005.

192178.overview:
A compilation that includes:

Cradle of Rome
Cradle of Athena
Cradle of Egypt

192193.overview: Cahiers de Vacances for Adults DS invites you to fall back into your childhood by testing the knowledge you learned at school and have forgotten since. Answer quizzes presented in a quirky and humorous way on the pitfalls of the French language, the major dates in history, the rules and concepts of Maths and English or general culture

192196.overview: Book of Holidays for Adults 2 on DS invites you to go back to childhood by testing the knowledge you learned at school and have since forgotten. Answer quizzes presented in a quirky and humorous way on the pitfalls of the French language, the major dates in history or the rules and concepts of math and English.

192197.overview:
C'est pas sorcier is the magazine of discovery and science for all audiences. It has been broadcast since September 1994 on
France 3, which makes it one of the oldest PAF programs currently being broadcast, with constant success.

The first
Nintendo DS experience box with FRED and Jamy. Around 4 captivating themes, the player teams up with Fred and Jamy to meet all their challenges. This completely new game for Nintendo DS is based above all on EXPERIMENTATION!

Using his console, the player will be able to carry out unique experiences and unravel the mysteries of the greatest scientific and natural phenomena.
The goal is simple: meet the increasingly heady challenges that Fred and Jamy launch.

192202.overview: The DS welcomes Laurent Romejko, Bertrand Renard and Arielle Boulin-Prat in this adaptation of the TV show Numbers and Letters. Throw yourself into this cerebral entertainment against a virtual opponent or a friend and grind your neurons to get out the most complicated words of the French language and the most elaborate calculations possible.

192206.overview: Cosmopolitan Total Relooking for Nintendo DS is a Makeover game in which you can have fun by making your own clothing experiments. Besides offering fashion-based games, the player can also find all kinds of mini-games: psycho test, quiz, love, zodiac sign compatibility, etc.

192210.overview:
Cuisine Party is a party game. At the beginning, you choose a cook from among five international cooks. After this step, you start a culinary championship where you have to confront another chef in every stage like in a TV show. The game contains 60 recipes with three levels of difficulty. It's possible to realize 20 different actions with the controller.

You can play in 2-player modes to have fun with a friend. Additionally, you can read the recipe book if you want to cook in real life.

192230.overview: Choose from more than a thousand crossword puzzles or hone your word skills with Wordsearch or Anagrams. No matter which type of puzzle you choose, you can easily save your progress at any time and return later to finish. Crosswords DS is designed for all players—just select your difficulty level and start off with a basic four-by-four puzzle. As you progress, the game will increase in difficulty and puzzle size. Use the DS stylus like a pencil to write or circle your answers on the touch-control screen. Erasing mistakes is as simple as writing the new answer over the old one. A hint system is also included in case you need some friendly assistance.

192307.overview: This combo pack contains the full versions of both Madagascar 3: The Video Game and The Croods: Prehistoric Party. It is loaded with action and adventure featuring your favorite DreamWorks Animation characters and is sure to provide hours of fun for kids of all ages. In Madagascar 3: The Video Game, adventure across Europe as Alex the Lion, Marty the Zebra, Gloria the Hippo and Melman the Giraffe while you find a way home under the perfect cover: a traveling circus. The Croods: Prehistoric Party. combines the ultimate fun of a family party game with Croods style action as you journey through 30 unique and addictive mini games.

203539.overview: Real Stories: Cheval Academy on DS is part of a range of games that offer many adventures and experiences for all girls. It is here in the company of the most beautiful horses that the game will take the players -and the players-, to fulfill many challenges (brush your horse, ride it in different environments, etc.).

203575.overview: Code de la Route: Edition Deluxe is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Micro Application, which was released in Europe in 2009.

205723.overview: For today's generation of parents of school-age children, one thing counts above all: They want their children to reach their learning goals quickly and directly and to achieve noticeable learning success. With these NDS titles, Cornelsen is now combining the successful console with highly efficient educational software. All tasks are based on the framework plans and the Cornelsen textbooks that are used in German schools. FEATURES: - Suitable for high school and junior high school - 8 types of exercise with over 1,000 language tasks - Story mode: 14 learning situations in one story - Training mode: grammar and vocabulary exercises that can be repeated as often and as required - Evaluation of personal learning progress - Numerous customizing Individual elements - Design of the interface - Exciting mini-games - Dual-player mode - English tutorial for grades 7 and 8

207132.overview: Chungjeon! Hanguginui Sangsingnyeok DS is a Puzzle game, developed and published by Studio9, which was released in Korea in 2007.

208845.overview:
Cave Story is a metroidvania platformer with the amnesiac soldier Quote finding a city of rabbits called Mimigas. The Mimigas are preyed on by an evil doctor, who kidnaps them for his evil experiments. They still remember Arthur, a hero from their past and others are awaiting for the return of Dragons. The soldier soon falls in with Sue, a stranger to the Mimigas, but the only one who seems to know about the Dragon Eggs. Unfortunately the doctor wants her next.

The game closely resembles a NES platformer with a distinct 8-bit style and fast gameplay. The main character collects weapons (blade, bubbler, fireball, machine gun, nemesis, (super) missile launcher, polar star, snake, and spur) that can be leveled up three times. There are also health capsules to increase his life bar. There is a variety of jumping puzzles and boss battles to challenge players as they explore the game.

The DSiWare version of the game is fairly close to the original and does not contain most of the changes introduced in the earlier WiiWare release. It however contains the Sanctuary Time Attack mode, seasonal costumes for Christmas and Halloween, and a jukebox where all tracks of the game's soundtrack can be gradually unlocked.

209047.overview: CTGP-Nitro is the biggest, most ambitious Mario Kart DS Rom Hack to date. Instead of replacing the existing tracks, it preserves the whole vanilla experience and adds new tracks, speedrunning quality of life improvements, online mode adjustments, new skins for characters and much more!

With "Cornelsen Trainer", students have access to NDS titles for the first time, which are completely curriculum-based and specifically refer to core school subjects - this is a novelty on the console market. In addition, there is the greatest need for tutoring nationwide in the subjects of English and mathematics, and Cornelsen, as the content provider, stands for quality and reliability. 

Another guarantee of success: According to the study, children and young people are curious about learning programs for game consoles and would like to try them out For today's generation of parents of school-age children, one thing counts above all: They want their children to get to the learning goal quickly and directly and to experience noticeable learning success. With these NDS titles, Cornelsen is now combining the successful console with highly efficient learning software. All tasks are based on the framework plans and the Cornelsen textbooks that have been introduced at German schools. This also ensures a suitable overlap for all federal states. The console is widely used for play purposes - and is now also an alternative when it comes to learning, both in school and in private life: the students can perform their daily exercises in a targeted manner. Last but not least, the Cornelsen training helps to prepare for learning objective controls.Great importance is also attached to the visually appealing design; variable forms of exercise are available, for example single and multiple choice exercises, drag & drop exercises or assignments.

The exercise forms also come with animations - and thus position the Cornelsen titles as consistent learning programs without frills. Graphics and diagrams are used in many places, the navigation is intuitive and informative evaluation tools clearly display the learning successes. 209627.overview: Cake Ninja 2 is the sequel to the very popular casual game, Cake Ninja, which was among the top 20 best-selling Nintendo DSiWare games in North America. Slide the stylus across the screen to slice cakes into small pieces like a true Ninja warrior.

209628.overview:
Another slice of the simple, fun and very popular game series!

Slide the stylus across the screen to slice snowballs into small pieces like a true Ninja warrior. The more snowballs you slice, the longer you survive and the higher your score. How long can you last?

209629.overview: Sparky has been entrusted to bring the light to the Crayon Castle before nightfall. Lead Sparky through over 100 colourful levels to collect matches and light candles. Don’t be surprised to find various obstacles like bombs, puddles, dynamite or dead ends! This unique and beautiful game will light a fire in the heart of every puzzle fan!

209630.overview: A critically acclaimed, high octane, action, driving and crime game with innovative real time gameplay, stunning visuals and an awesome soundtrack. Your gambling debts to the Italian mob are a million dollars and they are calling in the debt. Do you have what it takes to stay alive, pay your debt and rise to the top of the criminal underworld?

209631.overview:
Castle Conqueror is a real-time strategy game everyone can enjoy. You play a commander who must fight off the enemy empire and save the lives of the people. Lead your soldiers into battle, seize the enemy’s castle and win skirmishes until you destroy the empire on the mainland!

There are five chapters in total, each containing 10 stages. The male and female commander use different types of special cards to dictate events. The Gold cards you receive after completing a stage can be used to upgrade your attributes or to buy items.

209632.overview:
The god of the island bestows his blessing upon you, and you have his power to curse the invaders and save your tribe.

You are a great warrior from an ancient tribe on the island. Your island is a beautiful place where you worship the god of the island and he grants you and your tribe the powers that the island can bestow. The Empire suddenly arrived from the other side of the ocean, found gold mines and hunted down many innocent people; the fear of the Empire even made some tribes betray their faith. This has incurred the wrath of your god, and you must leave the safety of your hut to curse and punish the invaders.

209633.overview:
Be a hero: become a castle conqueror on "The Green Planet"!

When, fearing the outbreak of war, the government of The Green Planet surrendered to “The Empire”, The Empire sent a commander called Vilost to the planet. The new rulers then imposed heavy taxes and assumed military control, leaving the people to suffer extreme hardship under the strict regime. A revolt finally broke out, and a rebel leader emerged in the south of the planet; with this leader, the revolt grew in strength and number against The Empire. The leader is a woman called Veronica, and she is attempting to release the citizens imprisoned by the regime who are eager to join her rebel army. You were once a great soldier, and in joining the revolt, your objective (as well as that of your new forces) is to drive The Empire from your planet!

209634.overview:
Do you remember the war two years ago?

This beautiful star was a breathtaking green planet thriving with life, before it was devastated by the Empire's army.

The inhabitants refused to remain silent any longer, so they rose up and fought back. After they won a victorious battle over the Imperial army, a new government rose to maintain peace and the army left the planet.

209635.overview: This is our lovely island, and we will never allow the Empire to ruin it! You are a member of a family of military geniuses who came from the Empire, and have lived on a beautiful island for many years. Then the Empire arrived on the island: they now control everything, and are seeking valuable resources and gold. They have ruined the island's environment and have hunted down and killed the tribal people, some of whom were your friends. You must now stop the Empire and protect your people, by becoming a commander and leading your people against them. This is a revolution for you and the entire island!

209636.overview:
Be prepared to face anything and everything as you try to save your friend from the clutches of the horrifying magician Nefastax in Castle Of Magic!

To survive, you’ll have to stand up to wild monsters whilst exploring environments that directly influence your movement. In this platform-based universe, the ground will make you stick, slide, sink, swim, levitate, and even walk on the ceiling when gravity disappears!

As well as varied environments, giant bosses and beautiful environments, Castle Of Magic features innovative use of the Nintendo DSi Camera - allowing you to transform yourself into powerful new forms. Visit a Photo Cabin in the game and search for an object in real life that matches the colour of the character you want to transform into. Take a picture of a blue object with your Nintendo DSi Camera and abracadabra - you’re transformed into a swordfish! The Nintendo DSi Camera also comes into play as you customise in-game items using pictures of your choice.

Are you ready to dive into the unique world of Castle Of Magic?

209637.overview: Little kittens are trapped in a well, and it’s up to you to figure out how to get them out of trouble! Slide rows or columns of cute, cuddly cats to create chains of three or more of the same kind, in order to pull them out of the well. The game features both Mission and Quick Play modes, with a total of 140 levels that will engage you in hours of fun!

209638.overview: Patience will be key in order to score big in Chess Challenge! Perfect your chess skills playing against the computer in multiple difficulty modes, or play against your friends in either shared or wireless play via DS Wireless Communication. Start off practicing with some casual games and work your way up in fully ELO-rated matches. You’ll even be able to track all of your gameplay stats - win, lose or draw! Chess Challenge! will keep both novice and expert players glued to the screen for hours!

209639.overview:
Christmas Wonderland is a hidden object game featuring superbly detailed screens with lots of inter-level games and puzzles.

Santa and his team are working non-stop to get everything ready - but time is running out. Travel around a Wonderland crammed full of objects, with beautiful graphics and mini-puzzles for all the family to enjoy.

Can you help Santa find all the toys scattered around Wonderland and deliver the presents in time for Christmas?

Objects change with every play-through, increasing replayability and making this a game not to be missed.

209640.overview:
It’s Christmas time and Santa’s Elves are working non-stop to get all the toys made in time.

The Workshop is buzzing with activity and Wonderland is crammed full of fabulous toys, candy canes and Nativity characters. Santa must hurry to the Grotto in the Downtown Shopping Mall to see boys and girls before he flies around the World delivering all his presents. Meanwhile, Dan and Sally go shopping at the Mall before going home to put up the Christmas decorations. They can’t wait for Santa to come down their chimney ! Can you help Santa deliver all the toys in his amazing Winter Wonderland?

209723.overview:
In a green field there is a small hill, and on the hill there are flowers... wait, where have the flowers gone? It must have been the Heiress! The lively Heiress snuck out of the family mansion to follow a burglar out of curiosity. The burglar, Archer, immediately decided to kidnap the Heiress for ransom, and ordered his men to handle her with care. The Heiress is happy in Archer’s mansion. She doesn't realise her position, so she orders his men around.

In the meantime, her father (Mr. King) has received Archer's message and announced that anyone who brings back his daughter will receive a great reward. So a bunch of men, including those from other wealthy families, lead their forces to Archer's mansion...

209725.overview:
Step into the shoes of one of the four Elementalists each possessing their own superior power – fire, earth, air and water – and take to the battlefields in a fight for superiority!

Draw on the unique abilities of your chosen character and use their elements to counterattack from afar or in hand-to-hand combat. Destroy the other Elementalists in engaging and explosive rounds of single-play onslaughts, or compete with your friends via local wireless connection! Take the battle above the clouds or in the depths of ancient ruins as you fight for your Elementalist to be the only and final victor!

209726.overview:
Color Commando is a new and very cool puzzle platform game.

In this game you get to hunt for treasure! However, many evil colour monsters are blocking your path! Pick up colour blobs and try to outsmart the monsters!

In each level, colour monsters will block your path and try to grab you! So what can you do against this?

Collect paint blobs that are spread out over the level. You can use a paint blob to paint a big paint-spot on the world. If a monster of the same colour comes into contact with the paint-spot, the monster will dissolve into the spot. When this happens the monster cannot harm the player!

The game starts out easy enough, but before you know it you'll be surrounded by many different types of monsters in all different colours!

There are five worlds, each with four normal levels and one star level. You can unlock the star level by getting all the treasure in the other four levels!

209727.overview:
The kingdom is under attack by the dragons' army!

As the most skilled protector of the kingdom, you must strike back against the invaders with your mastered archery. With enemies appearing everywhere, how can you possibly defeat them with a single bow? No problem! The engineers have invented various types of traps. Use them wisely to mount defensive lines, and defeat the evil dragons!

209728.overview:
Pilot the Cosmos X2 to defend your planet against the alien invasion.

Pilot the Cosmos X2 to defend your planet against the alien invasion. Battle your way through the solar system to the alien home world to defeat their army. Equip your ship with two weapons of your choice and switch between them at any time during battle. Your active weapon takes damage when your ship gets hit. Defeating enemies regenerates energy in your inactive weapon. The key to your survival lies in finding a balance in your weapon usage.

Battle your way through six levels of action. Three difficulty levels will test your skills. Three bonus modes provide additional challenges.

209729.overview:
The objective is to switch two objects to make a horizontal or vertical set of three or more objects of the same colour. The player can win various awards by matching more objects and creating combos. The game contains colourful graphics, a Crazy Cheebo character and lots of humorous videos.          

You will have even more fun when you compete against your friends in multiplayer games where you can show everyone who is the best player!

209730.overview:
Chickens have invaded a movie studio, starting a hilariously messy rampage around the film sets and properties! It's time to take position in the director's seat, reload the shotgun and aim with precision at these winged intruders!

Shoot down the right number of chickens and stage props in order to progress to the next take and solve tons of brainteasing riddles for bonus points. Movie fans and action lovers will have a blast playing this game.

The lights are on, the cameras are rolling and now it's time for some feathery shooting action!

209731.overview:
Chicken Island is home to countless perils, hidden extras, and pirates who are by no means willing to surrender themselves without a fight.

Point and shoot at birds as they scurry through the island, and plunge bravely into the waves. Complete your raid by slaying pirates and collecting hidden treasures.

209733.overview: Welcome to "Crazy Golf"! Experience the world's wackiest miniature golf courses! Seven different courses with six different holes will put your skills to the test. Play alone or challenge your friends in multiplayer mode and show them who's the true champ!

209734.overview:
Winter is coming, but Crazy Hamster has forgotten to store up supplies. Now he has to visit different lands to get them before winter sets in.

Crazy Hamster is so crazy, that he sees nothing but the tempting fruits in his path.
The lands he visits are full of traps and obstacles but he doesn't even notice. You have to help him and neutralise those traps. There's no time to lose! Crazy Hamster has already set off!

209735.overview:
Now this is true madness!

Mission? Capture the hens that lay the golden eggs that are scattered around the world.

How? By creating a giant tower tall enough to reach the clouds where the hens are.

How to build the tower? Firstly, you must knock over some goats that rest on candy-made platforms scattered along the river. Secondly, fish out the goats you have knocked into the water. Finally, and this isn't easy, stack the captured goats one on top of the other until you've built the tower and can reach the hens that lay the golden eggs.

Using what? A super high-powered speed boat, and a crane with a hook attached for fishing and building the tower.

If you enjoy madcap adventures, do not hesitate to take the controls of our character Dundee the Mad Crocodile. Good luck!

209736.overview: Crazy Sudoku! "Play Sudoku on the go and anywhere you want on your Nintendo DSi!" The game features five different levels of difficulty – a challenge for Sudoku beginners and pros alike! Choose from two different grid sizes! (9x9 or 6x6) With the handy Note feature you can add comments to each and every cell and solve even the hardest Sudokus! Or try challenging a friend with the brilliant two player mode!

209737.overview:
In the outskirts of the kingdom, there are rare crystals containing a secret magical energy inside them. Rumour has it that a sorcerer is collecting the crystals in a tower for some reason, but no one knows where or if the tower actually exists...

As the most famous bounty hunter in the kingdom, you've been hired to seek out and investigate the tower’s location. At last you find the tower, but it has already been overrun by a large group of monsters intent on performing a dark ritual to summon a highly dangerous demon!

Although the demon has been summoned, you must stop the continuing ritual and kill the demon before it gains full power... or everything will be destroyed!

209738.overview:
Unlock the riches of the legendary Crystal Caverns of Amon-Ra by capturing the crystal spheres before they reach the Pit of Fire! Blast through over 1000 action-packed levels in 10 dazzling worlds filled with twists and turns, winding caverns and crystal sphere teleports. Catch magic hieroglyphs sent by Amon-Ra to help you in your quest, including Laser, Bomb, Paint, Reverse and more. Test your strategy and skills with 3 game modes and tons of explosive action!

Crystal Caverns features classic gameplay enhanced by easy-to-use controls and lots of surprises. With three different game modes, 10 amazing worlds to discover and 14 special power-ups, it's the perfect combination of action and puzzle fun!

209739.overview: As a Neo-Seed with the power to see and train monsters, it's time to set off on a journey to collect over 160 monsters and become the greatest Monster Breeder! Explore a vast world, meet new friends and rivals and battle with skill and strategy to win! Master the nine elemental types, train your monsters through battle, teach them new moves and team attacks and fuse them together to unlock their true potential. You can even customise three of your favourite monsters using the inner camera.

209740.overview:
Curling is the world famous sport in which players slide stones across a sheet of ice toward a target area, the "house". Two teams, each of four players, take turns sliding heavy stones, also called "rocks".

You can challenge your friends to a multiplayer game to show everyone who the best player is!

209741.overview:
In Cute Witch! runner get ready to set off on an adventure as your character flies away on her broomstick to a peaceful world inhabited by fantasy characters.

Cute Witch! runner is a challenging action game where you have to fly, fly more and then fly even more! Get all 32 achievements and become number one on the score table. At first, everything is easy – you pick up stars, you earn score points and you fly around the creatures – but soon you'll be involved in an unleashed race where you'll have to put your reflexes to the test to avoid every obstacle in your way.

How long do you think you'll resist flying?

209861.overview: Soar through the sky, from the comfort of your sofa, with the innovative gliding game Face Pilot! Face Pilot not only puts your face into the game with the Nintendo DSi camera, it also tracks your head's movements giving you complete control of your glider. Simply tilt your head sideways to steer left and right, back to climb, and forwards to dive. There are three different types of gameplay: burst all the balloons to reach the goal, throw balls at targets for a high score, and try for a fast time in the high speed challenge. Also, look out for hidden medals which help unlock new courses and even new gliders! Face Pilot is a truly unique game that wouldn't be possible without Nintendo DSi. The only thing missing is the wind in your hair!

210138.overview:
From Japan comes a new kind of board game that combines puzzle and strategy in a battle of wits. Take turns against human or computer opponents to reach a target score, by placing numbered tiles on the board.

Score points by linking the arms of each tile in various ways: tiles with the same number or sequence of numbers, and tiles in a loop. Also look out for special squares that affect play in new ways, and useful items that aid you in your pursuit of points.

Go it alone in the main Story or Puzzle modes, or battle against up to three opponents across the world via Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection. You can even learn from your past with History mode, showing the moves recorded during previous Nintendo WFC contests.

210179.overview: In Crash-Course Domo, you'll guide Domo across the finish line in six increasingly difficult bicycle races. Steer Domo around other racers and patches of rough terrain, pedaling as fast as his stubby legs will allow.

212231.overview: Clueless Fashion (also known as Clueless or Clueless: Girls in Beverly Hills) is an unreleased video game made for the Nintendo DS, intended to be a tie-in for the 1995 comedy film Clueless. The game was developed by Glyphic Entertainment and was set to be published by 505 Games. The game was possibly intended to be released in Europe on February 26th, 2010,[1] with no other planned releases being known (though the game is rated by the ESRB, meaning that a North American release was also likely intended).

213620.overview:
Choose one of five familiar card games and prove your skills against the system or a group of your friends!

Clubhouse Games comes to DSiWare with a collection of five fun card games in Clubhouse Games Express: Card Classics. Play familiar favorites like Blackjack and Five Card Draw or test your ability in the fast-paced Last Card, Last Card Plus, and President. DS Download Play allows players to host as many as seven friends.

213621.overview:
Choose one of five family-friendly games and prove your skills against the system or a group of your friends! 

Choose from five family-friendly games in this Nintendo DSiWare version of the popular Clubhouse Games. Play classic card games like Hearts and Contract Bridge, connect bones to other bones in Dominoes, think strategically in the simple, but addictive Dots and Boxes, and move your pieces towards a common goal in Ludo. Play by yourself or use DS Download Play to host as many as seven friends.

213622.overview:
Choose one of five strategy-based games and prove your skills against the system or a group of your friends!

Prepare yourself for a lesson in tactics as you play through five strategy-based games in this Nintendo DSiWare version of the popular Clubhouse Games. Take on an opponent in the classic Backgammon, invade an enemy base in Field Tactics, sandwich your opponent’s pieces to capture them in Turncoat, create strings of five in a row in Connect Five, and guess where to attack your opponent’s pieces in Grid Attack. Play by yourself or use DS Download Play to host as many as seven friends.

420680.overview:
Crash Tag Team Racing was a 2005 racing game that was developed by Radical Entertainment and published by Vivendi Games (under the Sierra Entertainment label) It was released on October 19th, 2005 for the PlayStation 2, Xbox and GameCube and later on November 10, 2005 for the PlayStation Portable.

The Nintendo DS port of Crash Tag Team Racing was not going to be a direct port like other versions that were to be released (due to the technical limitations of the system), rather it would be as similar as possible to the other releases. For example, Sensory Sweep gave the character artists at Radical Entertainment character models from the console versions and entrusted them with scaling down the models so that they could fit in the Nintendo DS version. The character artists instead made entirely new character models (the character models that Sensory Sweep gave them, when toned down, made them lack detail and look boxy). The race tracks and the layouts of the tracks were to be based on the other versions of Crash Tag Team Racing as well.

The Nintendo DS port of Crash Tag Team Racing was in development for 9-10 months before it was cancelled. The Nintendo DS port was only 1 to 2 months away from being completed. It was stated that the reason for the cancellation was that another racer, Mario Kart DS was going to be released during the same period of time that Crash Tag Team Racing would be on the market and Sierra thought the game wasn't going to sell well. There are also rumors that the game was cancelled because of management issues between Sensory Sweep and Sierra Entertainment.
